_comment: The concern groups the harness's schema modules sit in. Moved here from cat-harness/schemas/ with the modules (bean 8lcl), by code from code-lists/concern-group.json (placement PR8, bean f8wp). Regrouped one group per PR (owner, 2026-10-24); a module not yet regrouped stays at the top level, with a one-release re-export left at the old path of each one that moved. A higher instance's same-named `schemas/<group>/` is a MEMBER of the group declared here (bean 1g4s, option A).
